label: Rank
help: How worth a detour it is: Amazing (go out of your way), Nice (worth a stop if you're near), Okay (a footnote, for completists).

label: Heritage status
help: Official listing: rijksmonument (national) and/or gemeentelijk monument (municipal).

label: Listed in
help: Year it was designated a monument.

label: Artist
help: Who made the mural or artwork.

label: Status
help: Set when the thing no longer exists; the pin marks where it was.
